t: The promise he took out for people he might wrong
a: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَتَّخِذُ عِنْدَكَ عَهْدًا لَنْ تُخْلِفَنِيهِ فَإِنَّمَا أَنَا بَشَرٌ فَأَىُّ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ آذَيْتُهُ شَتَمْتُهُ لَعَنْتُهُ جَلَدْتُهُ فَاجْعَلْهَا لَهُ صَلاَةً وَزَكَاةً وَقُرْبَةً تُقَرِّبُهُ بِهَا إِلَيْكَ يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ
p: Allāhumma innī attakhidhu ʿindaka ʿahdan lan tukhlifanīh. Fa-innamā anā bashar. Fa-ayyu-l-muʾminīna ādhaytuhu, shatamtuhu, laʿantuhu, jaladtuhu, fa-jʿalhā lahu ṣalātan wa zakātan wa qurbatan tuqarribuhu bihā ilayka yawma-l-qiyāmah
m: O Allah, I take a covenant with You that You will not break with me. I am only a human being. So any believer I have harmed, or insulted, or cursed, or struck, make it for him a prayer and a purification and a nearness that brings him close to You on the Day of Resurrection.
